specification.missing: numeric constant zero plus fixed missing indicators; categorical unknown sentinel
specification.nonlinear: clock/720 squared; margin/30 squared; margin/30 times clock/720; home times margin/30
specification.selection: tune possession logloss; first grid value breaks ties; no train+tune refit

paired_logloss.target: expected paired game loss sum divided by expected game possession count
paired_logloss.assumption: independent identically distributed whole games with finite moments
paired_logloss.limitations: No training/selection uncertainty or calendar/series dependence correction; percentile coverage is not guaranteed.
